result.summary: I committed 1906aee, which makes the standard permit the library's combat park for the category registration. options-ui-§5's "register eagerly" rule now says: when CreateOptionsPanel is called under InCombatLockdown(), the library MAY park the registration. If it does, it MUST replay it exactly once at PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED, parking again if combat is still on, whatever the host's stand-down state. The host still calls CreateOptionsPanel once at PLAYER_LOGIN and MUST NOT add its own park. options-ui-§9's "never taints" and "must happen eagerly" passages now point to the park, and so does options-ui-§2's registration note.
